literal: King of Qin-Jin Chun's wife Virtuous Consort Xiao five times memorialized Jin, asking to set up the Prince of Qin; it was not permitted; strong troops guarded Juyong.
idiomatic: King of Qin-Jin Chun's wife Virtuous Consort Xiao five times memorialized Jin, asking to set up the Prince of Qin; it was not permitted; strong troops guarded Juyong.

literal: When Jin troops reached the pass, the barrier stones collapsed of themselves; many garrison soldiers were crushed to death; without fighting they scattered.
idiomatic: When Jin troops reached the pass, the barrier stones collapsed of themselves; many garrison soldiers were crushed to death; without fighting they scattered.

literal: The Virtuous Consort went out Gubei Pass and hastened to Tiande Army.
idiomatic: The Virtuous Consort went out Gubei Pass and hastened to Tiande Army.

literal: Twelfth month, learning the Jin lord had pacified Nanjing, Tianzuo thereupon went out Saoli Pass to dwell in the four tribal departments' xiangwen households.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, learning the Jin lord had pacified Nanjing, Tianzuo thereupon went out Saoli Pass to dwell in the four tribal departments' xiangwen households.

literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on dingsi day Xi king Huilbao usurped the title, styled era Tianfu first year; commander-in-chief Mage was ordered to attack him.
idiomatic: In the third year, on dingsi day of the first spring month Xi king Huilbao usurped the title, styled era Tianfu first year; commander-in-chief Mage was ordered to attack him.

literal: On jiazi day, earlier Zhang Cang had been Liao Xingjun Army associate military commissioner; [6] the people pushed Cang to lead prefectural affairs.
idiomatic: On jiazi day, earlier Zhang Cang had been Liao Xingjun Army associate military commissioner; [6] the people pushed Cang to lead prefectural affairs.

literal: After King of Qin-Jin Chun died, Virtuous Consort Xiao dispatched Shi Li'ai to know Ping Prefecture affairs.
idiomatic: After King of Qin-Jin Chun died, Virtuous Consort Xiao dispatched Shi Li'ai to know Ping Prefecture affairs.

literal: Cang knew Liao would perish; he drilled troops and gathered horses and registered strong youths as preparation.
idiomatic: Cang knew Liao would perish; he drilled troops and gathered horses and registered strong youths as preparation.

literal: When Li'ai arrived, Cang would not admit him.
idiomatic: When Li'ai arrived, Cang would not admit him.

literal: Jin commander Nianhan entered Yan and first asked Ping Prefecture affairs of former third-rank knower of government affairs Kang Gongbi.
idiomatic: Jin commander Nianhan entered Yan and first asked Ping Prefecture affairs of former third-rank knower of government affairs Kang Gongbi.

literal: Gongbi said, "Cang is arrogant and short of counsel; though he has local troops, what can he do?
idiomatic: Gongbi said, "Cang is arrogant and short of counsel; though he has local troops, what can he do?

literal: Show him no suspicion; plotting against him is not yet late."
idiomatic: Show him no suspicion; plotting against him is not yet late."

literal: The Jin summoned Shi Li'ai to the army front and advanced Cang to Linhai Army military commissioner, still knowing Ping Prefecture.
idiomatic: The Jin summoned Shi Li'ai to the army front and advanced Cang to Linhai Army military commissioner, still knowing Ping Prefecture.

literal: Afterward they again wished to send three thousand elite troops first to take Ping Prefecture and capture Zhang Cang.
idiomatic: Afterward they again wished to send three thousand elite troops first to take Ping Prefecture and capture Zhang Cang.

literal: Gongbi said, "If troops are added, that would hurry him to rebellion."
idiomatic: Gongbi said, "If troops are added, that would hurry him to rebellion."

literal: Gongbi asked to go himself to observe.
idiomatic: Gongbi asked to go himself to observe.

literal: Cang said to Gongbi, "Of Liao's eight routes, seven have already surrendered;
idiomatic: Cang said to Gongbi, "Of Liao's eight routes, seven have already surrendered;

literal: only Ping Prefecture has not laid down arms—guarding against Xiao Gan."
idiomatic: only Ping Prefecture has not laid down arms—guarding against Xiao Gan."

literal: He richly bribed Gongbi and returned.
idiomatic: He richly bribed Gongbi and returned.

literal: Gongbi again told Nianhan, "He is not worth worry."
idiomatic: Gongbi again told Nianhan, "He is not worth worry."

literal: The Jin thereupon changed Ping Prefecture to Nanjing and advanced Cang to acting Zhongshu Menxia pingzhangshi, judging regent affairs.
idiomatic: The Jin thereupon changed Ping Prefecture to Nanjing and advanced Cang to acting Zhongshu Menxia pingzhangshi, judging regent affairs.

literal: On gengchen day Yi, Jin, Qian, Xian, Cheng, Chuan, Hao, Yi, and other prefectures in succession all surrendered; Supreme Capital Lu Yanlun rebelled and killed Khitan people.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Yi, Jin, Qian, Xian, Cheng, Chuan, Hao, Yi, and other prefectures in succession all surrendered; Supreme Capital Lu Yanlun rebelled and killed Khitan people.

literal: Second month, on yiyou new moon Xingzhong Prefecture surrendered to Jin.
idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the second month Xingzhong Prefecture surrendered to Jin.

literal: Laizhou Guide Army military commissioner Tian Hao, acting Xi Prefecture military commissioner Du Shihui, acting Qian Prefecture military commissioner Gao Yongchang, acting Run Prefecture military commissioner Zhang Cheng—all registered their governed households in surrender to Jin.
idiomatic: Laizhou Guide Army military commissioner Tian Hao, acting Xi Prefecture military commissioner Du Shihui, acting Qian Prefecture military commissioner Gao Yongchang, acting Run Prefecture military commissioner Zhang Cheng—all registered their governed households in surrender to Jin.

literal: On bingxu day Virtuous Consort Xiao was executed; Chun was demoted to commoner; all his faction were fully released.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Virtuous Consort Xiao was executed; Chun was demoted to commoner; all his faction were fully released.

literal: On guisi day Xingzhong and Yi prefectures again held the cities in defense.
idiomatic: On guisi day Xingzhong and Yi prefectures again held the cities in defense.

literal: Third month, the court halted at south of Yunnei Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the third month the court halted at south of Yunnei Prefecture.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiashen new moon, [appointed] knower of Northern Court privy affairs Yelü Dashi. [sentence incomplete in source]
idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the fourth summer month Tianzuo appointed Yelü Dashi to know Northern Court privy affairs. [source sentence breaks off here]

literal: On wuxu day Jin troops surrounded baggage at Green Mound; Hard Stockade Protector Temuge secretly took Prince Liang Yali and fled; Prince of Qin, Prince of Xu, various consorts, princesses, and attending ministers all were lost.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Jin troops surrounded baggage at Green Mound; Hard Stockade Protector Temuge secretly took Prince Liang Yali and fled; Prince of Qin, Prince of Xu, various consorts, princesses, and attending ministers all were lost.

literal: On gengzi day Liang-Song great elder princess Teli fled home.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Liang-Song great elder princess Teli fled home.

literal: On renyin day Jin sent men to summon.
idiomatic: On renyin day Jin sent men to summon.

literal: On guimao day he answered asking for peace.
idiomatic: On guimao day he answered asking for peace.

literal: On bingwu day Jin troops sent clan and baggage east; he then dispatched troops to intercept battle at White Water Marsh; Prince of Zhao Xini Lie and Xiao Daoning were both captured.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Jin troops sent clan and baggage east; he then dispatched troops to intercept battle at White Water Marsh; Prince of Zhao Xini Lie and Xiao Daoning were both captured.

literal: Tianzuo dispatched seal-bearer gentleman Moluwa to send the rabbit-gold seal in false surrender and thereupon fled west to Yunnei.
idiomatic: Tianzuo dispatched seal-bearer gentleman Moluwa to send the rabbit-gold seal in false surrender and thereupon fled west to Yunnei.

literal: Consort's husband commandant Runu went to Jin in surrender.
idiomatic: Consort's husband commandant Runu went to Jin in surrender.

literal: On jiyou day Jin again sent a letter to summon; he answered the letter.
idiomatic: On jiyou day Jin again sent a letter to summon; he answered the letter.

literal: On renzi day the Jin commander's letter came, not permitting a request for peace.
idiomatic: On renzi day the Jin commander's letter came, not permitting a request for peace.

literal: That month Temuge brought Yali; Tianzuo was angry he could not fully save his sons and questioned him.
idiomatic: That month Temuge brought Yali; Tianzuo was angry he could not fully save his sons and questioned him.

literal: Fifth month, on yimao day Xia State king Li Qianshun dispatched envoys asking Tianzuo to visit his state.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the fifth month Xia State king Li Qianshun dispatched envoys asking Tianzuo to visit his state.

literal: On gengshen day army generals Yelü Dilie and others by night seized Prince Liang Yali and fled to the northwest interior, setting him up as emperor and changing the era to Shenli.
idiomatic: On gengshen day army generals Yelü Dilie and others by night seized Prince Liang Yali and fled to the northwest interior, setting him up as emperor and changing the era to Shenli.

literal: On xinyou day they crossed the river and halted north of Jin Su Army.
idiomatic: On xinyou day they crossed the river and halted north of Jin Su Army.

literal: Huilbao was killed by the masses.
idiomatic: Huilbao was killed by the masses.

literal: Sixth month, envoys were dispatched to invest Li Qianshun as Xia State emperor.
idiomatic: In the sixth month envoys were dispatched to invest Li Qianshun as Xia State emperor.

literal: Autumn, ninth month, Yelü Dashi returned from Jin.
idiomatic: In the ninth autumn month Yelü Dashi returned from Jin.

literal: Winter, tenth month, again crossed the river east and returned, dwelling in the Tulu Bu tribe.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court again crossed the river east and returned, dwelling in the Tulu Bu tribe.

literal: Prince Liang Yali died; Yelü Shulie succeeded him.
idiomatic: Prince Liang Yali died; Yelü Shulie succeeded him.

literal: Eleventh month, Shulie was killed by the masses.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month Shulie was killed by the masses.

literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, Tianzuo hastened to commander-in-chief Mage's army.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the first spring month Tianzuo hastened to commander-in-chief Mage's army.

literal: Jin men came to attack; abandoning camp he fled north; Mage was captured.
idiomatic: Jin men came to attack; abandoning camp he fled north; Mage was captured.

literal: Moheshi came to welcome, presenting horses, camels, and sheep, and again led his department to guard.
idiomatic: Moheshi came to welcome, presenting horses, camels, and sheep, and again led his department to guard.

literal: At that time attendants lacked grain for several days and exchanged clothing for sheep.
idiomatic: At that time attendants lacked grain for several days and exchanged clothing for sheep.

literal: Arriving at the Wugu Dilie tribe, chief palace-front inspector Xiao Yixue was made knower of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs; Moheshi was enfeoffed Spirit-at-Khan King of Yue.
idiomatic: Arriving at the Wugu Dilie tribe, chief palace-front inspector Xiao Yixue was made knower of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs; Moheshi was enfeoffed Spirit-at-Khan King of Yue.

literal: Temuge surrendered to Jin.
idiomatic: Temuge surrendered to Jin.

literal: Second month, Yelü Yaoshe and ten others plotted rebellion and were executed.
idiomatic: In the second month Yelü Yaoshe and ten others plotted rebellion and were executed.

literal: Summer, fifth month, Jin having already taken Yan, drove Yan's great families east; they gave Yan's empty city and Zhuo, Yi, Tan, Shun, Jing, and Ji prefectures to Song to seal the alliance.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month, Jin having already taken Yan, drove Yan's great families east; they gave Yan's empty city and Zhuo, Yi, Tan, Shun, Jing, and Ji prefectures to Song to seal the alliance.

literal: Zuo Qigong, Kang Gongbi, Cao Yongyi, and Yu Zhongwen all were moved east.
idiomatic: Zuo Qigong, Kang Gongbi, Cao Yongyi, and Yu Zhongwen all were moved east.

literal: Yan people drifted on the roads, unable to bear the suffering; entering Ping Prefecture they spoke to regent Zhang Cang, saying, "Chancellor Zuo Qigong did not plan to defend Yan and made our people drift with nowhere to settle.
idiomatic: Yan people drifted on the roads, unable to bear the suffering; entering Ping Prefecture they spoke to regent Zhang Cang, saying, "Chancellor Zuo Qigong did not plan to defend Yan and made our people drift with nowhere to settle.

literal: You now hold a great post and grasp strong troops; if you are wholly loyal to Liao you can surely let us return to our native places—the people's hearts also look only to you."
idiomatic: You now hold a great post and grasp strong troops; if you are wholly loyal to Liao you can surely let us return to our native places—the people's hearts also look only to you."

literal: Cang thereupon summoned the various generals to debate.
idiomatic: Cang thereupon summoned the various generals to debate.

literal: All said, "We hear Tianzuo's military power has revived again, appearing and disappearing south of the desert.
idiomatic: All said, "We hear Tianzuo's military power has revived again, appearing and disappearing south of the desert.

literal: If you by righteousness aid the king and welcome Tianzuo to plan restoration, first charge Zuo Qigong and others with the crime of surrendering in rebellion and execute them, fully return Yan people and let them resume their livelihoods, and then offer Ping Prefecture to Song, then Song will have none who do not receive us; Ping Prefecture will thereupon be a frontier defense.
idiomatic: If you by righteousness aid the king and welcome Tianzuo to plan restoration, first charge Zuo Qigong and others with the crime of surrendering in rebellion and execute them, fully return Yan people and let them resume their livelihoods, and then offer Ping Prefecture to Song, then Song will have none who do not receive us; Ping Prefecture will thereupon be a frontier defense.

literal: Then if later Jin adds troops, using Ping Mountain's army within and gaining Song as outer aid, what is there to fear!"
idiomatic: Then if later Jin adds troops, using Ping Mountain's army within and gaining Song as outer aid, what is there to fear!"

literal: Cang said, "This is a great affair and cannot be done hastily.
idiomatic: Cang said, "This is a great affair and cannot be done hastily.

literal: Hanlin academician Li Shi is clever and full of plans; he may be summoned to debate."
idiomatic: Hanlin academician Li Shi is clever and full of plans; he may be summoned to debate."

literal: When Shi arrived, his words agreed with theirs.
idiomatic: When Shi arrived, his words agreed with theirs.

literal: Thereupon he dispatched Zhang Qian leading more than five hundred horsemen, transmitting the regent's order, to summon chancellors Zuo Qigong, Cao Yongyi, privy commissioner Yu Zhongwen, and third-rank knower of government affairs Kang Gongbi to the west bank of the Luan River; he sent discussion officer Zhao Mishu to enumerate several tens of crimes, [7] saying, "Tianzuo is driven to wander at Jia Mountain and you do not at once welcome him—one;
idiomatic: Thereupon he dispatched Zhang Qian leading more than five hundred horsemen, transmitting the regent's order, to summon chancellors Zuo Qigong, Cao Yongyi, privy commissioner Yu Zhongwen, and third-rank knower of government affairs Kang Gongbi to the west bank of the Luan River; he sent discussion officer Zhao Mishu to enumerate several tens of crimes, [7] saying, "Tianzuo is driven to wander at Jia Mountain and you do not at once welcome him—one;

literal: you urged Imperial Uncle King of Qin-Jin Chun to usurp the title—two;
idiomatic: you urged Imperial Uncle King of Qin-Jin Chun to usurp the title—two;

literal: you slandered the lord and father and demoted him to Xiangyin—three;
idiomatic: you slandered the lord and father and demoted him to Xiangyin—three;

literal: Tianzuo dispatched knower of Prince of Min Youqing to discuss affairs and you killed him—four;
idiomatic: Tianzuo dispatched knower of Prince of Min Youqing to discuss affairs and you killed him—four;

literal: when the proclamation first arrived you had a plan to welcome Qin and resist Xiang—five;
idiomatic: when the proclamation first arrived you had a plan to welcome Qin and resist Xiang—five;

literal: you did not plan to defend Yan and surrendered—six;
idiomatic: you did not plan to defend Yan and surrendered—six;

literal: not considering great righteousness, you served as ministers to Jin—seven;
idiomatic: not considering great righteousness, you served as ministers to Jin—seven;

literal: you searched out Yan wealth to please Jin—eight;
idiomatic: you searched out Yan wealth to please Jin—eight;

literal: you made Yan people migrate and lose their livelihoods—nine;
idiomatic: you made Yan people migrate and lose their livelihoods—nine;

literal: you taught Jin to send troops first to take Ping Prefecture—ten.
idiomatic: you taught Jin to send troops first to take Ping Prefecture—ten.

literal: You have ten crimes and cannot be forgiven execution."
idiomatic: You have ten crimes and cannot be forgiven execution."

literal: Zuo Qigong and others had nothing to answer; all were strangled.
idiomatic: Zuo Qigong and others had nothing to answer; all were strangled.

literal: They still styled the year Baoda third year, painted Tianzuo's image, morning and evening paid respects; affairs had to be reported before acting; they styled Liao official ranks.
idiomatic: They still styled the year Baoda third year, painted Tianzuo's image, morning and evening paid respects; affairs had to be reported before acting; they styled Liao official ranks.

literal: Sixth month, a notice was posted telling Yan people to resume livelihood; permanent property occupied by the Ever-Victorious Army was all returned.
idiomatic: In the sixth month a notice was posted telling Yan people to resume livelihood; permanent property occupied by the Ever-Victorious Army was all returned.

literal: Yan people having obtained return were greatly pleased.
idiomatic: Yan people having obtained return were greatly pleased.

literal: Hanlin academician Li Shi changed his name to An Bi and with former three-department commissioner Gao Dang went to Yanshan, persuading Song's Wang Anzhong, saying, "Ping Prefecture has more than ten thousand armored men; Cang has civil and military talent and may be used as a screen;
idiomatic: Hanlin academician Li Shi changed his name to An Bi and with former three-department commissioner Gao Dang went to Yanshan, persuading Song's Wang Anzhong, saying, "Ping Prefecture has more than ten thousand armored men; Cang has civil and military talent and may be used as a screen;

literal: otherwise he will be a trouble at the elbow."
idiomatic: otherwise he will be a trouble at the elbow."

literal: Anzhong deeply agreed; he ordered An Bi and Dang to go to Song.
idiomatic: Anzhong deeply agreed; he ordered An Bi and Dang to go to Song.

literal: The Song lord decreed the commander Wang Anzhong and Zhan Du to treat them generously and exempt three years' regular levies.
idiomatic: The Song lord decreed the commander Wang Anzhong and Zhan Du to treat them generously and exempt three years' regular levies.

literal: Cang hearing this thought himself to have succeeded in the plan.
idiomatic: Cang hearing this thought himself to have succeeded in the plan.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, Jin men encamped at Laizhou; hearing Ping Prefecture had attached to Song, with two thousand horsemen they demanded satisfaction, [8] first entering Ying Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Jin men encamped at Laizhou; hearing Ping Prefecture had attached to Song, with two thousand horsemen they demanded satisfaction, [8] first entering Ying Prefecture.

literal: Cang with ten thousand elite horsemen defeated them.
idiomatic: Cang with ten thousand elite horsemen defeated them.

literal: Song established Ping Prefecture as Taiping Army, made Cang military commissioner, made An Bi and Dang Huaiyou Gate attendants-in-waiting, and ordered the pacification office to issue several tens of thousands in silver and silk as reward.
idiomatic: Song established Ping Prefecture as Taiping Army, made Cang military commissioner, made An Bi and Dang Huaiyou Gate attendants-in-waiting, and ordered the pacification office to issue several tens of thousands in silver and silk as reward.

literal: Cang was pleased and went far to welcome.
idiomatic: Cang was pleased and went far to welcome.

literal: Jin spies learned; raising troops they came to raid; Cang could not return and fled to Yan.
idiomatic: Jin spies learned; raising troops they came to raid; Cang could not return and fled to Yan.

literal: Jin took three prefectures and then came to demand Cang; Wang Anzhong concealed him.
idiomatic: Jin took three prefectures and then came to demand Cang; Wang Anzhong concealed him.

literal: The demand urgent, he beheaded one whose appearance resembled him and sent him off.
idiomatic: The demand urgent, he beheaded one whose appearance resembled him and sent him off.

literal: The Jin said it was not Cang and with troops came to take him.
idiomatic: The Jin said it was not Cang and with troops came to take him.

literal: Anzhong had no choice and killed Cang, boxed his head, and sent it to Jin.
idiomatic: Anzhong had no choice and killed Cang, boxed his head, and sent it to Jin.

literal: [9] Tianzuo having obtained forest-academician Yelü Dashi's troops returned, and also Moheshi troops of Yinshan Shive, thought himself Heaven-aided and again planned to raise troops to recover Yan and Yun.
idiomatic: [9] Tianzuo having obtained forest-academician Yelü Dashi's troops returned, and also Moheshi troops of Yinshan Shive, thought himself Heaven-aided and again planned to raise troops to recover Yan and Yun.

literal: Great Stone forest-academician strongly remonstrated, saying, "From when the Jin first took Changchun and Liaoyang, the traveling carriage was unlucky at Guangping Marsh and the court was at Central Capital;
idiomatic: Great Stone forest-academician strongly remonstrated, saying, "From when the Jin first took Changchun and Liaoyang, the traveling carriage was unlucky at Guangping Marsh and the court was at Central Capital;

literal: when Supreme Capital fell, the court was at Yanshan;
idiomatic: when Supreme Capital fell, the court was at Yanshan;

literal: when Central Capital fell, the court went to Yunzhong;
idiomatic: when Central Capital fell, the court went to Yunzhong;

literal: from Yunzhong the court was driven to wander at Jia Mountain.
idiomatic: from Yunzhong the court was driven to wander at Jia Mountain.

literal: Hitherto with full armies you did not plan battle preparations, letting the whole state's Han lands all become Jin's.
idiomatic: Hitherto with full armies you did not plan battle preparations, letting the whole state's Han lands all become Jin's.
